The local sample weight is n/(n+150) × √(n/N), where n is the number of compatible observations and N is the baseline fleet. Each other component contributes up to 250 observations, weighted threefold within the same group of regions. If the aircraft family is known, only valid cabin layouts for that family are considered. When type or layout is unknown, the model uses the regional profile informed by other regions. Whole-aircraft totals are reconciled by the largest-remainder method.

A weight estimate would need to include the computers, sensor and actuator interfaces, cooling and redundancy. The control-surface actuators would still be required. We found no comparable installed weights for both configurations on the 757.

text.У исходного Ту-214 основной контур управ: The baseline Tu-214 has a digital primary flight control channel, an analog electrical backup and separate emergency control. Options include replacing the analog computing units while retaining an independent control path. The SEI-85 and KISS systems already provide electronic cockpit displays.
